newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Union Bank of Hong Kong FRCD increased.
newsitem.headline: Union Bank of Hong Kong FRCD increased.

text.p: Union Bank of Hong Kong's five-year floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been increased to US$55 million from US$50 million in syndication, arranger Bayerische Landesbank Hongkong said.
The certificates were priced at par to float at 45 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate. There are put and call options in year three and four.
With fees, the all-in return for top tier managers is 66 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$10 million each, are Bayerische Landesbank Hongkong and Jardine Fleming Bank.
Senior managers, with US$5 million each, are Australia and New Zealand Banking Group, Bank Austria Hongkong and Bayerische Vereinsbank Hongkong.

Managers are Banca Nazionale del Lavoro SpA Hongkong, Bank of Hawaii Hongkong, Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur Hongkong, Den Danske Bank Hongkong, Hang Seng Bank and Schroders Asia, with US$3 million each, and BCOM Finance (Hong Kong), with US$2 million.
Signing is set for October 8. The deposit date is October 15.
